channel.title: The Logical Indian - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: Delhi Chokes On 349 AQI: Flights And Trains Delayed As Government Enforces Strict Pollution Norms
item.description: Delhi's AQI remains "very poor" at 349, causing flight delays and a strict fuel-restriction crackdown.

item.title: Delhi BJP Councillor Apologises After Telling African Coach to ‘Learn Hindi or Stop Using Park’
item.description: A viral park-side confrontation between Delhi BJP councillor Renu Chaudhary and an African football coach has reignited debates on language, power and dignity in public spaces.

item.title: Eminent Hindi Writer Vinod Kumar Shukla, Chhattisgarh’s First Jnanpith Winner Aged 89, Dies in Raipur After Health Battle
item.description: The literary world mourns Vinod Kumar Shukla, whose simple prose and 2025 Jnanpith Award elevated everyday stories to profound heights before his passing at AIIMS Raipur.

item.title: Junoon ’25 Honours Northeast Grassroots Group Pioneering Climate Resilience Through Indigenous Wisdom
item.description: RNBA earns Junoon '25 acclaim for pioneering community-led, nature-based models like SALT and FORLIS that restore ecosystems and livelihoods across 368 villages in India's Northeast.

item.title: Indian-Origin Woman Found Dead in Canada, Partner Named Prime Suspect; Nation-Wide Manhunt Launched
item.description: Toronto Police have launched a national manhunt for Abdul Ghafoori following the murder of Indian national Himanshi Khurana.

item.title: Ramesh Kharmale’s Green Mission: Ex-Army Man & His Family Revives Dhamankhel Hill, Traps Rainwater & Boosts Local Ecology
item.description: An ex-soldier from Pune has gained national acclaim for single-handedly transforming Junnar’s barren hills into lush forests.

item.title: India’s First Transgender Football League Kicks Off in Kolkata, Empowering 200+ Players
item.description: Kolkata's groundbreaking eight-day tournament unites 16 teams of over 200 transgender athletes, fostering inclusion through football amid historic rights advocacy.

item.title: Leading From the Front: Sunil Chhetri’s Remarkable Rise as an Indian Football Legend
item.description: Sunil Chhetri has amassed 252 career goals, cementing his status as India's greatest ever striker and a global icon.

item.title: Delhi Man Quits Corporate Job in 2019 to Lead Earth Warriors Cleaning Yamuna, 12 States Tonnes Waste
item.description: Pankaj Kumar quit corporate life to found Earth Warriors, cleaning rivers weekly across 12 states.

item.title: Amma’s Pride: Trans Filmmaker Shiva Krish’s Doc on Tamil Nadu’s First Trans Marriage Eyes Oscars
item.description: A Tamil documentary chronicling a mother's support for her trans daughter's pioneering marriage in Tamil Nadu has qualified as India's sole trans-led Oscar contender.
